limits: This is a source-and-native-token derivation, not an isolated boundary-position forward ablation. The planned recorded fixed-weight forward differences change the complete historical-versus-length attention mask and empirically measure the combined effect, without assigning a separate causal contribution to each boundary.
shifted_prediction_interpretation: Each logit at sequence position t predicts the input token at t+1; labels at t+1 select whether that prediction is included in the sequence mean.
The two earlier prompt im_end positions can supply attention context to assistant predictions.
The assistant im_end target is predicted from the preceding sequence position; changing attention at that boundary cannot affect its own prediction through that same future input position.

All actual assistant im_end input positions are penultimate, not final. The logit at that position predicts a supervised trailing newline (token 198), so correcting its attention mask can affect that final prediction.

An attention mask changes key/value availability; it does not delete the token embedding, every residual path, or any assistant target label. The im_end and trailing newline remain supervised in both arms.
The 2160 count describes masked input positions. These positions have different locations and downstream supervised contexts; it is not a count of 2160 equally influential loss contributions.
